description: Unroll a public X thread into its posts in order. For a single post, use get_tweet instead. Expensive upstream — call sparingly, and prefer pasting the thread's LAST post, which returns the whole chain. Results may be partial; the response says so when they are.

url_or_id.description: Post URL (x.com or twitter.com), bare numeric ID, or text containing one

name: get_thread
